purpose: Join items in a formal list.
keywords: Please enter your name and address.
Smoking is prohibited inside the building and on the grounds.
We keep reserves of water and food.
restrictions: Corresponds to “and”; often joins items of comparable rank.
mistake: Use と or や in ordinary casual conversation.

segments.role: Join items in a formal list. N + 及び + N

examples.translation: Please enter your name and address.
examples.note: A formal list of required information.
